timeline.label: LIGHTS OUT
timeline.text: Second on the grid into Turn 1, holding the inside line.

timeline.label: THE LEAD
timeline.text: Into the lead on lap 3 and clear of DRS range by lap 6.

timeline.label: STOP 1
timeline.text: Medium to hard, 2.4s. Emerges third behind two cars yet to stop.

timeline.label: BACK IN FRONT
timeline.text: Net lead restored once the alternate strategies cycle through.

timeline.label: STOP 2
timeline.text: Hard to hard, 2.3s. A ten-second gap held through the stop.

timeline.label: THE FLAG
timeline.text: Wins by 19.561s. The 106th Grand Prix victory, and the first in red.
